page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head above it and the page number at the top right. Below the text: the signature "M 2" at the bottom left and the catchword "Tusn-" at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

p.i: dis hæ scriptæ, signataque: Omnes & singuli totius provinciæ ordines, qui Amasfo & Lavicâ continentur, retinerent jura & privilegia sua per manus à majoribus accepta, leges patrias, statuta, consuetudines: imperium Præfecturæ veteris, & Selwerdiæ suburbanæ esset ac maneret civitatis: munitiones per agrum omnes, quæ jam essent, everterentur; nec aliæ in futurum extruerentur, nisi id defensionis requireret necessitas: domus Principe digna, sed inermis & immunita Cæsari ædificaretur in urbe, sumptibus provinciæ totius: reditus ex agro solverentur Cæsari & hæredibus ejus quotannis duodecies mille aureorum Carolinorum.

main_text.p: Dammona capta à Teuteburgio totâ Drentiâ Geldri ejecti, Wedda, Coverdiaque captæ, bellum ex universâ illâ vicinia, eodem adhuc anno profligatum.

Denique Decembri mense pax inter Burgundiam domum & Geldrum composita. Conditiones dictæ inter alias, ut fœderi Gallico, Holsatico, aliisque contra Cæsarem & subditos ejus initis, Geldrus renunciaret: valediceret juri omni in civitatem & agrum Groninganum, Drentiam

page.notes: The running head and the page number are printed in italic and roman. The catchword "Tusn-" is a guess: the long s is hard to read and the scan is faint at this place, so I marked it [?]. Italic and roman changes in the first and last lines are approximate. "Conditiones dictæ inter alias, ut fœ-" is set partly in roman, and I have marked the italic from "ut fœ-" onward. The last paragraph runs on to the next page.
